content:
Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

- Paras. 5.3 and 5.4.  
7. Recovery of subscription for a month will be effected from the pay for that month, i.e., for January, from the pay for January payable on the last day of January. - Para. 9.3.  
Subscription is payable till the end of service including the month in which an employee retires, dies, resigns, or is removed from service. If an employee dies during a month before recovery of subscription for that month, his dues will be paid after deducting the subscription.
